paragraphs.text: DSH 侧栏余额栏：自动显示官方账号余额，点击在 DSH 内查询用量
# DSH Sidebar Balance Bar
English | 中文
`dsh-balance-bar` is a community desktop plugin (not an official DeepSeek product), compatible with
DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2. It adds a persistent top-up balance bar in the native `sidebar.footer
.action` slot, above the existing account entry. It does not replace that entry, modify core code, i
nject positioning DOM, or start an additional service.
## Behavior
- Uses Host `deepseekAccount.getBalance()` and the current login, without reading credentials or pas

sing them to the frontend.
- The Client reads every 10 seconds; the Host queries upstream on demand,
with a minimum interval of 30 seconds and coalesced concurrent requests. Reads pause while the page
is hidden and resume with a check when the window returns, still respecting the cache interval. Thi
s is not real-time server push. Clicking the bar uses the same `globalThis.dshPlatform.open('usage',
bounds)` bridge as the native button to embed the official usage page inside DSH, without opening a
n external browser. The plugin provides a back button, viewport-size synchronization, and cleanup on
close; the native bridge still manages credentials. The entry is disabled when the desktop bridge i
s unavailable or the account is signed out. This bridge depends on the current desktop version and m

ust be reverified after upgrades.
- Top-up and promotional balances are not added together. The main
bar shows the top-up balance; the tooltip shows the promotional balance and update time. An empty w

allet displays `—`, not a fabricated zero balance.
- The Host listens for account changes and clears
its cache, using generation checks to discard in-flight responses from before an account switch. Th
e frontend reflects sign-out no later than the next successful read. Network failures clear the fron

tend amount; upstream Host failures retain the old amount with an explicit stale indicator.
- Collap
sing the sidebar hides the balance bar; the original account entry remains clickable. All requests,
subscriptions, timers, styles, and registrations are cleaned up on plugin unload. The upstream servi
ce does not accept cancellation parameters; already-started requests can only have their results dis

carded after completion.
- The local `/myspace-balance-bar/api` route restricts requests to loopback
, a valid Host, same-origin Origin/Fetch Metadata, and a custom request header. Only local browsers
are supported; CORS is not provided.
## Development and installation
Install the npm package `dsh-balance-bar` through the DSH plugin manager. No API key is required: it
uses the official account currently signed into DSH. Only the desktop profile is supported; do not
install it in the Web profile.
No build is required; the native ModuleLoader Client ships in the package. For development, install
`link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-balance-bar`. Disabling the bundle removes the balance bar. Restarting D
SH after an upgrade is recommended to avoid running old code from the Host module cache.
Disable or uninstall the old local package `myspace-dsh-balance-bar` before installing this package.
Do not enable both at once: they share route and slot identifiers.
Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-balance-bar.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Verification covers balance caching, request coalescing, failure states, sign-out and account switch
ing, discarding in-flight responses on unload, and request-origin validation. The balance bar and em
bedded official usage page have been verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop. The centered loading spinne
r has been checked in code, but its loading phase has not been captured separately on the real appli
cation. Account sign-out is covered by isolated tests; acceptance testing does not sign the user out
ation. Account sign-out is covered by isolated tests; acceptance testing does not sign the user out.
## Limitations
- Balances are polled, not pushed in real time; statistics on the official usage page may be delayed

.
- The native embedded page uses the current desktop bridge; navigation in an ordinary browser is n

ot supported.
- Loading shows only a centered spinner, without explanatory text. It does not rotate

when the system prefers reduced motion.
- This plugin does not collect account credentials, upload b
alances, or provide top-up operations.
## Trusted publishing
The publishing workflow uses GitHub Actions OIDC without storing an npm token. Run it manually on `m
ain` with the reviewed full commit SHA in `expected_sha`. `dry_run` defaults to true; set it to fals
e only for an approved new-version publication. The workflow rejects a mismatched SHA before publish
ly for an approved new-version publication. The workflow rejects a mismatched SHA before publishing.
In the npm package's Trusted Publisher settings, configure GitHub Actions, owner `fegnze`, repositor
y `dsh-balance-bar`, and workflow `publish.yml`, leaving Environment empty. The npm account owner mu
st complete two-factor authentication for this configuration; committing the workflow alone does not
establish authorization.
